finalText:
Both green: 625/625 passing and `verify.js` confirms the fix is legitimate (spec/runner untouched, correct rule implemented).

The bug: `orderTotal` in `src/pricing.js` was computing tax on the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted amount, even though the doc comment said tax should apply to "what's actually owed." Fixed by computing tax on `discounted` instead of `cents`.
